scenes.text: A reflection is a mirror image across a line. Every point stays the same distance from the line.
Reflect (3, 3) in the y-axis. The answer is (-3, 3). Reflection in the y-axis changes the sign of x only.
A point during a library project has coordinates (1, 7). Reflect it across the vertical y-axis. What is the new point? Pause to choose and explain.
A point during a library project has coordinates (1, 7). Reflect it across the vertical y-axis. What is the new point? The answer is (-1, 7). Reflection in the y-axis changes the sign of x only.
